purpose: analyst targets + PER for watchlist analytics view (phase 1)
collectionMethod: WebFetch was unavailable for every candidate financial-data domain in this session (stockanalysis.com, tipranks.com, marketbeat.com, finance.yahoo.com, www.wsj.com, www.zacks.com, www.benzinga.com, www.cnn.com, www.marketwatch.com, www.nasdaq.com, www.tradingview.com, www.investing.com, www.wallstreetzen.com, 247wallst.com, www.gurufocus.com, www.sec.gov, www.cnbc.com all returned EGRESS_BLOCKED or unreachable, confirmed even against example.com). All figures below were instead retrieved via the WebSearch tool with allowed_domains restricted to the named source, which returns an AI-generated synthesis of that domain's indexed snippets plus the exact source URLs. Figures are transcribed as reported by each search; where a source's page shows a % upside/downside instead of a raw current price, the implied price was back-calculated from that percentage and is flagged 'implied: true'. No cross-source reconciliation was performed (validator's job). Explicit 'as of' page-timestamp text was not retrievable via search snippets for most sources; retrievedAt reflects this collection session, not a source-stamped date.
